principle: MAYHEM uses verified snapshots, never COMPLETE.
integrity_rules: Never use post-start live evidence to rewrite a frozen pre-event decision.
Live observations may reconcile event lifecycle state.
A displayed live state must expose source and last verified time.
If refresh fails or age exceeds the implementation freshness threshold, mark the state stale rather than implying it is live.
A finished live feed does not itself create VERIFIED_RESULT; result verification remains a governed transition.
Sport-specific scoring and period structures belong in implementation adapters, not this portable contract.

nrl_primary_source_capability.architecture_note: Implementation must use a lawful reliable acquisition path and retain source capture provenance.
